_comment: Tracks compiled WASM binary size over time. Updated automatically by CI on every build.

entries.note: Dependency audit (#1515): reviewed `cargo bloat --release --crates` output. Removed unused dev-only crates from the release build and feature-flagged optional dependencies out of the WASM target. Binary shrank by 1 KB (102400 -> 101376); limit_bytes lowered accordingly. Further reduction not viable: remaining size is dominated by core contract logic and required runtime crates (soroban-sdk, serde, core).
